items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses Billie Holiday's relationship with Lester Young ('Prez') and gives advice to 'baby' (likely referring to a younger woman or perhaps a misremembered context, but not explicitly linking himself to Billie), but does not state a personal relationship with Billie Holiday herself

ctx.x: Billy watch Ben too? Billy never --
No. Billy was hanging out with Blanton. So he was a tag along, you know, he was real, real passive, you know.
Yeah, he would never argue with anybody.
